'''Login Rewards''' ---- '''Login Rewards''' are gifts that are obtained by joining the game on a '''daily''' basis. The rewards get better with each day, with the streak being reset if they are not claimed in the amount of time required.
==Current Login Rewards== [[File:DailyRewards2024.png|thumb|250px]] '''Login Rewards''' have 28 days worth of rewards, which are repeated after the final day, without any reward scaling for higher streaks. When the final day is claimed, the streak's number does not reset. day, the rewards will repeat themselves, though each day will increase by 30. }} ==Before 19th of July 2024== [[File:DailyRewards.png|thumb|250x250px]] [[File:DailyRewards2.png|thumb|250x250px]] Prior to the [[v1.26.0]] Update, '''Login Rewards''' had 7 in a streak. You could have earned {{Coins|800}} in total, every cycle, from '''Daily Rewards'''. The rewards are the same for each cycle. '''Login Rewards''' were called ''Daily Login Rewards'' and ''Login Streak Rewards'' while these rewards were used, with the former name being replaced by the latter with a UI change. The '''Daily Rewards''' system itself was ran on a 24-hour timer, meaning that you could claim rewards 24 hours after the last one. After 48 hours of a reward not being claimed, the streak was broken and you were reset back to Day 1. Rewards: *Day 1 – {{Coins|50}} *Day 2 – {{Coins|100}} *Day 3 – {{Coins|150}} *Day 4 – {{Coins|200}} *Day 5 – [[Basic Crate]] *Day 6 – {{Coins|300}} *Day 7 – [[Premium Crate]] ==Before 29th of October 2020== [[File:Daily Rewards.png|thumb|250x250px]] Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Login Rewards''' system was slightly different than the version after said update. It ran on a 12-hour timer, meaning that you could claim rewards 12 hours after the last one. This meant that you could get two rewards in one day, timed well enough. With this daily reward system, you could claim {{Coins|1,050}} in total, every cycle. '''Login Rewards''' was referred to as ''Daily Rewards'' during this time period.
